restorationContract.bounded: Release actual replacement owners before deleting identity maps; preserve shared owners and all page style changes.
restorationContract.composedScopes: Incrementally revisit existing connected shadow roots and assigned slot content affected by visibility attributes; keep unrelated components unchanged.
restorationContract.typography: Refresh only copied uniform source typography; retain Text references across owned stashes, omit owned wrappers, clear stale copied properties, preserve page overrides on translation chrome and source.
restorationContract.media: Remove installed owned CSS when source attributes, rendered source, parent, root, transform/position or owning row contract no longer apply; preserve original nodes and inline edits.
restorationContract.lifecycle: Coalesce owned layout updates per frame, ignore own style mutations, refresh while translations are paused, cancel all work on restore, issue no translation requests for presentation changes.
restorationContract.restore: Keep original/current node identities, values, order, links and page edits; do not revive sources deleted by the page; repeated restore and mode switches are required.
restorationContract.validation: Pre-fix failing tests, positive/shared-owner controls, fresh Chromium and Firefox artifacts, full functional tests and performance budgets, 16:9 live website samples.

limits: GitHub 的提交信息及计数、网页轮播和动画会使前后截图不同；恢复按操作前的当前页面状态校验。
Svelte 和 Apple 原有裁剪候选保持不变；GitHub 导航结构发生变化后，冻结基准复查也出现相同的 2 个隐藏标签裁剪候选和 1 个挤压候选。
Firefox 的页面行为通过 Gecko 内容脚本测试验证，原生扩展加载另有套件覆盖。
纯 CSSOM 或 adoptedStyleSheets 修改、且没有 DOM/视口/系统配色事件的样式变化未新增拦截。
